snippet.title: The Steam page for Orrin’s Chessboard is now LIVE!
snippet.description:
Orrin’s Chessboard is a strategy game that blends Tower Defense, Cards, and a Dynamic Board into a fresh tactical experience.
Every turn generates new tiles, routes, and resources, letting you build, adapt, and outsmart endless waves of enemies.

🧩 Features:
• Dynamic board that changes every turn
• Resource management & tower upgrades
• Card shop with controllable randomness
• Four themed chapters: Forest, Autumn, Desert, Snow

📅 Demo on Nov 28
🚀 Launches Dec 5

👉 Wishlist on Steam to support the game!
